decision_verdict.rationale: Over 94.6% of observed boundary errors stem from truly inconsistent, arbitrary annotation conventions (e.g. chassis codes like 8V, W204, B9 and generation numerals like 4, 7 being arbitrarily merged vs split into separate entities with ~50% inclusion rate). Under precision-heavy F0.2 (beta=0.2), any deterministic rule or neural span prior attempting to resolve these coin-flip boundaries incurs catastrophic false-positive penalties (1 FP destroys 25 TPs), as empirically confirmed in Phase 50 (+313 FPs, -0.035 F0.2 regression). The frozen Phase 40 champion represents the optimal precision-calibrated consensus.
